items.title: Unit 1 · Lesson 1 story
items.storyText:
Look at the train, Rosy. A train? Oh, Billy!

They're my school things. Look, what's this? It's a pen.

And what's this? It's a rubber.

That's right. Can I have my school things, please? OK, here you are … Your pencil, pen, ruler and rubber.
